comment_regular: Verified numeric lock magnitude to LOCK_LEVEL mapper. Thresholds are iLockLevelMaxVeryEasy, iLockLevelMaxEasy, iLockLevelMaxAverage, iLockLevelMaxHard, and iLockLevelMaxVeryHard; outputs 0..5 map through LockLevelNames to VeryEasy, Easy, Average, Hard, VeryHard, Impossible. Fallout independently uses the matching LOCK_LEVEL names, but this mapping is directly established by Oblivion code and data.
